text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text: Urgh... I don't like this place one bit...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うう……
なんだかいやな雰囲気だよぅ……

text_block_list.name: Chika
text_block_list.text:
Foggy's presence seems to have attracted
all sorts of wicked beings.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……どうやら
フォギーの力に引かれて、
悪しき者たちが集まってきているようですね。

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry!
If they wanna be naughty,
then I'll give them a good spanking! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫だよ！
わるい子はみーんな、
私がお仕置きしちゃうんだからぁ♪
